All products featured on Glamour are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links.

Shopping for your loved ones is hard, but it doesn’t have to be. Add a personal touch by shopping for the best personalized gifts on Amazon. The mega-retailer isn’t just overflowing with top-rated, trending [gift ideas](https://www.glamour.com/gallery/amazon-gift-ideas); many are actually customizable, too, making it the perfect place to find thoughtful ideas for holiday gifts, birthdays, and other special occasions like Valentine’s Day or Christmas. Plus, in July, Amazon tends to mark down many of these unique gifts during its [Amazon Prime Day sale](https://www.glamour.com/amazon-prime-day).

## Our top picks:

- Best for Pets: [Awesometik Personalized Pet Portrait, $30](https://cna.st/affiliate-)
- Best for Her: [Amazon Collection Oval Hand Engraved Locket Necklace, from $85](https://cna.st/affiliate-)

Whether you’re heading to your best friend’s [baby shower](https://www.glamour.com/gallery/best-baby-shower-gifts) and looking for a special keepsake or in search of a last-minute [custom gift for a housewarming party](https://www.glamour.com/gallery/best-housewarming-gifts), we curated a list of some of the best personalized gifts on Amazon. web.markdown:
![Best Amazon Handmade Items](https://nypost.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/09/handmade.png?w=744)
New York Post Composite

See more of our coverage in your search results.

[Add The New York Post on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=nypost.com)

We found the Etsy of Amazon.

Not only is the retailer’s [Amazon Handmade](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FHandmade%2Fb%3Fie%3DUTF8%26node%3D11260432011%26tag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb) collection positively precious in every way, but it’s a great one-of-a-kind catalog to shop if you’re on the hunt for a unique and personalized gift.

With some [Amazon best-sellers](https://nypost.com/article/amazon-best-sellers-products-finds-2022/) thrown into the mix, you’ll understand why everyone’s raving about the assortment of items available to add to your cart online. From its curated [gift shop](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fgcx%2FGift-shop%2Fgfhz%2Fevents%2F%3F_encoding%3DUTF8%26categoryId%3Dhandmade-EGgiftshop%26language%3Den_US%26ref_%3Dsv_hand1_1%26tag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb) to [wedding collection](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fb%3Fnode%3D23728163011%26tag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb), you’ll be swooning left and right.

Not only that, but there’s unique [home decor](https://nypost.com/article/best-home-products-on-amazon/) and jewelry items worth exploring. Whether you’re looking for a nifty new fashion statement for a friend or a simply fabulous [gift for the couple you know](https://nypost.com/article/best-gifts-for-couples/), Amazon Handmade has you covered.

Ahead, shop our 15 favorite items from the retailer’s hidden gem on the internet. We’re obsessing just as much as you’ll be.

## 1\. [Petite Boutique 16K Gold Your Name Bar Bracelet](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fdp%2FB015NSJ11W%2F%3Ftag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb), $20

[![Petite Boutique 16K Gold Your Name Bar Bracelet](https://nypost.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/09/1-29.png?w=1024)](https://nypost.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/09/1-29.png)Amazon

You can’t beat this $20 bracelet. Leaning into [fine jewelry](https://nypost.com/article/best-affordable-fine-jewelry/) territory, Petite Boutique’s 16K Gold Your Name Bar Bracelet makes the perfect custom gift that’s bound to match any outfit. If you’re looking into gold jewelry, you may as well pick up something with your gift recipient’s name on the on-trend bar.

[BUY NOW](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2Fdp%2FB015NSJ11W%2F%3Ftag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb)

* * *

## 2\. [Define Design Retro Mix Tape Cassette Light Switch Cover](https://r.nypostlink.com/?btn_ref=org-19984c113c692001&btn_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRetro-Cassette-Switch-Outlet-Switchplate%2Fdp%2FB07SPGCVRP%2F%3Ftag%3Dnypost-20%26asc_refurl%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fnypost.com%2F2022%2F09%2F19%2Fthe-15-best-items-from-amazon-handmade-personalized-gifts%2F%26asc_source%3Dweb), $16

[![Define Design Retro Mix Tape Cassette Light Switch Cover](https://nypost.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/09/2-31.png?w=1024)](https://nypost.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2022/09/2-31.png)Amazon
